title: The Forest Mystery
intro: This quiz follows two curious kids and Dr. Kim as they discover how producers, consumers, and decomposers work together in a forest.

questions.prompt: What are plants called because they make their own food?
questions.explanation: Plants are called producers because they make their own food.

questions.prompt: What do plants use to make their own food?
questions.explanation: Plants use sunlight, water, and carbon dioxide to make their own food.

questions.prompt: Why is the rabbit called a consumer?
choices: It eats plants to get energy
It returns nutrients to the soil
questions.explanation: The rabbit is called a consumer because it eats plants to get energy.

choices: Break down dead plants and animals
questions.explanation: Decomposers break down dead plants and animals.

questions.prompt: How do decomposers help new plants grow?
choices: They return nutrients to the soil
They remove water from the soil
questions.explanation: Decomposers help new plants grow by returning nutrients to the soil.
